name: Chopped vox hook
desc: Future bass chopped-vocal lead from shabda TTS words (moonlight, higher, forever, paradise) — sliced, pitched with speed patterns, vowel-morphed and delayed into a melodic hook. Peak stutters chop(16) with iter rotation. If the external TTS pack is slow to warm the groove still stands without it.

code.full: s("<moonlight higher forever paradise>").chop(8).speed("<${pitch} 1.25 .75 1.5>").vowel("<a o e i>").hpf(250).shape(.3).delay(${wet}).delaytime(.25).delayfeedback(.4).room(.35).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.6, ${gain}).fast(4)).orbit(5).play()
code.peak: s("<moonlight higher forever paradise>").chop(16).iter(4).ply("<1 2 1 1>").speed("<${pitch} 1.5 2 .75>").vowel("<a o e i>").hpf(250).shape(.35).delay(${wet}).delaytime(.19).delayfeedback(.45).room(.3).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.65, ${gain}).fast(4)).orbit(5).play()
